assignment: Ordinary execution work without a more specific boundary.

rules.instruction: Execution responsibility general: stay within the assigned Role, composed Responsibilities and current packet. Read Manifest.md every assignment and apply new User Input and Assignment amendments. Previous passing checks do not prove newly requested work was completed. Report this round's result or exact unmet need to the responsible Role. General applies once to every Role and is not a selectable Role. Evidence proves only the boundary it directly exercises.
Do not inspect a black-box script or tool implementation. Only an assigned specialized responsibility that explicitly overrides script-source-inspection may change this boundary.

Each Action owns one pull request; all rounds update that same PR. A local checkpoint is recovery state, not delivery. Worker owns the Draft and all implementation commits and validation. Coordinator owns final GitHub verification and the transition to Ready. Host scripts enforce these role boundaries and persist actual results. Preserve partial work and evidence on failure.

Reuse successful required validation for unchanged code and inputs. Do not repeat a passed gate through lower-level commands or a different entry point to restate its evidence. When a required Host tool is unavailable, report the exact missing capability to the Coordinator; do not search Host source, configuration or session history for a substitute implementation.
